proposed_comments.title: Cover synchronous IPC delivery results
proposed_comments.body: Add focused bounded tests for send_and_wait success, timeout, and failed delivery so shutdown behavior cannot regress silently.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: Suppressed Copilot finding is preserved as a maintainer-review action; no public inline range is being posted.

proposed_comments.title: Authenticate managed IPC receivers
proposed_comments.body: Both managed IPC endpoints currently start unauthenticated duplex input servers. Preserve client-only behavior or authenticate callers before accepting module commands.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: Suppressed Copilot finding is preserved as a maintainer-review action; no public inline range is being posted.

proposed_comments.title: Establish a bounded startup handshake
proposed_comments.body: Do not report Advanced Paste or PowerDisplay startup success before the child output pipe is available or a bounded failure signal is recorded; otherwise startup commands can be lost and unusable processes remain marked running.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: Suppressed Copilot finding is preserved as a maintainer-review action; no public inline range is being posted.

proposed_comments.title: Propagate Workspaces IPC delivery results
proposed_comments.body: The WorkspacesLib duplicate transport currently reports queue idleness rather than successful write delivery. Propagate write failure into send_and_wait before callers use its boolean result.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: Suppressed Copilot finding is preserved as a maintainer-review action; no public inline range is being posted.

proposed_comments.title: Test bounded IPC timeout and failure paths
proposed_comments.body: Add deterministic tests for a delayed peer and an unavailable or ended peer, including the false result and bounded completion behavior.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: Suppressed Copilot finding is preserved as a maintainer-review action; no public inline range is being posted.

proposed_comments.title: Protect the Advanced Paste input endpoint
proposed_comments.body: The managed Advanced Paste endpoint accepts duplex input without caller authentication; use a client-only input path or enforce the expected caller policy.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: Suppressed Copilot finding is preserved as a maintainer-review action; no public inline range is being posted.

proposed_comments.title: Protect the PowerDisplay input endpoint
proposed_comments.body: The managed PowerDisplay endpoint accepts duplex input without caller authentication; use a client-only input path or enforce the expected caller policy.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: Suppressed Copilot finding is preserved as a maintainer-review action; no public inline range is being posted.
